primaryClaims.answer: Blaksyd is Human + AI, revolving around you, building meaningful conversations through Blak, Persona, Minit, and Nexus.
Blaksyd was founded by Vishnu Sudagani, co-founder and CEO, and Dr. Sindhuu Devarakonda, co-founder and CPO.
Minit is not therapy. It is Blaksyd's trained human listening layer for private conversation and support.
